notes: INSIDE half of the Ion Blast: three teal coil capacitors that light one after another as it charges (frame 5 = all three bright, strip cyan), power coupling, hatch. fire: coils and strip discharge in a white flash. damaged: one coil unwinding, a lamp dead, sparks; disabled: coils scorched dark, a casing split. Barrel layer ion_blast_mk1_barrel: a slim core tube wrapped in three teal coils with a cyan emitter tip. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
